phan.noi_dung:
> **Shopping habits are changing**
> 
> Twenty years ago, most people in this country bought clothes in shops. They tried things on, checked the size and paid at the counter. Today, nearly half of all clothing is bought online. The main reason is price: online shops do not pay rent for city-centre buildings, so they can offer bigger discounts.
> 
> There are problems, however. Sizes are not the same in every brand, so customers often order two or three sizes and return the ones that do not fit. Around 30% of clothes bought online are sent back. This is expensive for companies and bad for the environment, because each return means another delivery.

**True / False / Not Given (6–8):**
6. More than half of all clothing is now bought online.
7. Online shops can offer lower prices partly because they have no city-centre rent.
8. Most customers prefer shopping online to shopping in stores.

**Hoàn thành câu (9–11):**
9. Twenty years ago most people bought clothes in ____________.
10. Customers often order several ____________ of the same item.
11. About ____________ of online clothing is returned.

writing.de_tom_tat: Viết 60–70 từ về lần gần nhất bạn mua quần áo: mua gì, ở đâu, giá bao nhiêu, có vừa không.
writing.bai_mau: Last month I bought a pair of jeans at a shop in the city centre. They cost four hundred thousand dong. I tried them on first because I wasn't sure about the size. The first pair didn't fit — they were too tight — so I asked the assistant if I could try a bigger size. The second pair fitted well, and the colour suited me.

cham_diem.vi_sao: fit nói về kích cỡ (didn't fit, fitted well) · suit nói về màu/kiểu có phù hợp với người không (the colour suited me). Dùng đúng cả hai.
I asked if I could try a bigger size — could lịch sự hơn can trong ngữ cảnh nhờ vả.
a pair of jeans, và sau đó thay bằng they vì jeans luôn số nhiều.
Mua gì · ở đâu · giá · có vừa không, có cả tình tiết đổi size.

dang_hoc: Đồ có 2 phần luôn số nhiều: jeans, trousers, shorts, glasses, scissors → đi với they/were.
fit = vừa cỡ · suit = phù hợp kiểu/màu · match = hợp với thứ khác.
“try something on” — phrasal verb tách được: try them on (không nói try on them).
loi_thuong_gap: ❌ The jeans was too tight → ✅ The jeans were too tight

speaking.de_tom_tat: Do you enjoy shopping? / Do you prefer shopping online or in shops? Why? / What was the last thing you bought?

cau_tra_loi.mau: Not really, to be honest. I only go when I actually need something. I find crowded shops quite tiring.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: Trả lời “không” cũng được điểm cao — miễn là có lý do. Đừng nghĩ phải trả lời tích cực.

cau_tra_loi.hoi: Do you prefer shopping online or in shops? Why?
cau_tra_loi.mau: Online, mainly because it's faster and I can compare prices. The downside is that clothes sometimes don't fit, so I still buy shoes and jeans in shops.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: “The downside is that…” — cấu trúc nêu mặt hạn chế, rất hữu ích cho Speaking Part 3 sau này.

cau_tra_loi.hoi: What was the last thing you bought?
cau_tra_loi.mau: A pair of running shoes, about two weeks ago. I'd been looking for a while and they were on sale, so I finally bought them.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: Câu hỏi quá khứ thì phải trả lời bằng quá khứ đơn: bought, were, had been looking.

cham_diem.vi_sao: Đủ, câu 2 có cả hai mặt.
clothes /kləʊðz/ — một âm tiết, không đọc thành “clo-thes”.

meo_noi: “on sale” = đang giảm giá · “for sale” = đang được bán. Hai nghĩa khác nhau.
Trả lời phủ định vẫn ăn điểm nếu có lý do rõ. Đừng bịa câu tích cực cho đẹp.
